title: avenor_message input
description: Discriminated-union input for the avenor_message tool. One complete object per action: every variant enumerates all the properties it permits and refuses the rest, so a field that belongs to another action is a schema error rather than a silently ignored key. The same admission rules are published as ActionApplicability in internal/messaging (Go) and assertMessageInput (TypeScript); TestSchemaMatchesRouteTable proves the two agree.

action.description: Deliver a message without creating a reply edge.

target.description: Recipient: a reserved self alias, a broker/runtime id, a host-surface public run id, or a peer label.

action.description: Deliver a message and wait for one reply.

target.description: Recipient: a reserved self alias, a broker/runtime id, a host-surface public run id, or a peer label.

timeout_ms.description: Bounded wait in whole milliseconds, at most the shared wait cap (600000); absent or zero uses the shared wait cap.

action.description: Answer an ask this surface received.

reply_to.description: Message id of the inbound ask, as an opaque handle.

action.description: Continue a finished run in a new run.

target.description: Prior run: a reserved self alias, a broker/runtime id, a host-surface public run id, or a peer label.

label.description: Display name for the new run; defaults to the prior run's label.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key that makes a repeated resume replay the first result.

action.description: Retract an ask this caller sent.

message_id.description: Message id of the ask to withdraw.

action.description: Answer a claude-channel control request; registered only on the claude-channel backend.

target.description: Opaque claude-channel control message id, passed through unchanged.

payload.description: JSON payload the control channel receives; absent sends an empty object.
